scoring_justification: Cannot recompute because the hidden verifier cannot rerun the full 3D phase-field simulation. The check verifies structural crystallographic properties (variant set membership and junction plane families) directly from the reported JSON.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the list of monoclinic variants present on the free (001)_t surface and the Miller indices (in the tetragonal frame) of junction planes between adjacent variants.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify that the reported variants correspond to correspondence C and that the junction plane Miller indices belong to the {100}_t or {110}_t families. Flexible naming conventions are accepted.

steps.check_description: Verify variants_on_free_surface belong to correspondence C (after stripping orientation suffixes) and that each junction plane's Miller indices (abs sorted) is either [0,0,1] or [0,1,1] (i.e., {100}t or {110}t).
